defects_found: GlobalFitModel.add_selected_fit / remove_selected_local_fit / add_global_parameter call self.fit.append_fit / remove_local_fit / append_global_parameter, which exist only on the model: the global-fit editor's Add/Remove buttons raise AttributeError (chisurf/core/models/global_model/globalfit.py:127/137/145); add_global_parameter also passes a name where append_global_parameter expects a Parameter.
Global-fit editor: the Local fits table does not refresh after a fit is appended.

After a global fit the member fit windows keep their local-fit curves and chi2; the global fit's Info tab reports chi2r = 1.0000 exactly -- worth checking whether the global fit updates the same fit objects the windows show.
Parse-Model link menu: the Parameters / All parameters submenus list every parameter of every catalogue equation (~150 names), not the six of the active formula.
FCS hub: the Correlator plots lag as 'Correlation time (ms)' while the FCS Merger plots the same curves against 'Lag time (s)', both with the decay at 1 -- one unit label is wrong.
Confocor3 files load as one group of four curves (AC1, AC2, CC12, CC21) per file; the FCS reader has no option to load a single channel.
